support_reply_1_prefix:
🔑 LOGIN & PASSWORD SUPPORT

* If you forgot your password:
Step 1: Go to the login screen, click on the text.
Step 2: Enter the exact Email you used to register.
Step 3: Open your Gmail app (or your email), find the email from SoulLocket and click on the blue Link to create a new password.

* If you encounter continuous wrong password errors:
Usually due to the keyboard automatically capitalizing the first letter. Please type carefully again and try uninstalling and reinstalling the app.
support_reply_2_prefix_1:
🔗 PAIRING SUPPORT & CONNECTION ERRORS

* Easiest way to pair:
Step 1: The other person's phone goes to Settings -> Get House Code with 12 numbers.
Step 2: Your phone presses the Pair button and enters those 12 numbers.

* Showing inaccurate offline error:
This is not a house disconnection error! It happens due to the network transmission being delayed for a few seconds. You just need to try turning off 4G/Wifi and turning it back on or just leave it for a while and the app will automatically sync back the word 'Online'.

📸 IMAGE, VIDEO AND DIARY ERROR SUPPORT

* Uploaded photos are blurry, black screen:
When you are saving photos or videos, the device needs a network to push them to the system. Absolutely DO NOT SWIPE to another screen or turn off the app when the 100% rotation is not finished loading!

* Cannot find diary updates:
Just hold your finger in the middle of the screen and swipe down hard (Refresh) and the latest data will jump out immediately.

🧾 ACCOUNT AND BENEFIT SUPPORT

* If you need to check the status or benefits in the application:
Step 1: Open the exact screen that is experiencing the problem.
Step 2: Take a screenshot of the display notification if there is an error.
Step 3: Send a short description of what you just did so the Admin can check.
support_reply_5_prefix:
📱 HOW TO CHANGE PHONES WITHOUT LOSING DATA

* You never lose data:
All photos and diaries of the couple's house are always automatically attached to the account and 100% safely preserved on the network.

* The most standard way to change phones:
Step 1: On the Old phone, you absolutely must leave the application as it is and must not delete the House.
Step 2: Take the New phone, download the app.
Step 3: Remember carefully what Google or Login Name you used before? Fill in exactly the same on the new phone and the memories will flood back.
